summary: A great list for hockey fans (Gretzky, Jagr, Crosby passing Yzerman), but a typical player knows four or five names and burns lives on McDavid and Bobby Orr. Free play, and a strong pick for a sports-themed day.
reasons: Casual run (sports-aware): Gretzky, Crosby, Ovechkin, Lemieux, Howe, Jagr, Messier (7/10), with McDavid (#47), Orr, Kane, Brett Hull and Malkin taking all five lives. A non-fan stops after Gretzky, Crosby, Ovechkin and Lemieux.
Fan gets 10/10 with Sakic (#11) as the perfect near miss. Values look current through the 2025-26 season (Crosby 1,761 above Yzerman), though the packet says data as of 2025.
Bobby Orr is accepted with no stat, so he costs a life in classic and scores nothing in Blitz, and the reveal can't show why (915 points).
